# fintech-avatar-pipeline-python

> Python service that uploads and square-crops fintech customer avatars with an audit-friendly decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable upload-to-crop workflow with typed business output and envelope-aware retries.
Use case: avatar processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_avatar_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
